title: Their leader got young men so high they'd jump off a wall for him. Or so his enemies said. 🗡️
caption:

first_comment: Tag the friend who'd follow you anywhere 👇
sources: Daftary F. (1994) 'The Assassin Legends: Myths of the Isma'ilis' (I.B. Tauris) (the hashish legend as an outsider's slur; no evidence of drug use)
Lewis B. (1967) 'The Assassins: A Radical Sect in Islam' (Weidenfeld & Nicolson) (Hasan-i Sabbah took Alamut in 1090 and reportedly did not leave it for 35 years; targeted killings)
